---
title: "Contato"
---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")

endereco <- as.character(cfg$endereco_completo)
mapa_url <- paste0(
  "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=",
  utils::URLencode(endereco, reserved = TRUE)
)
telefone <- as.character(cfg$telefone)
telefone_url <- paste0("tel:", gsub("[^0-9+]", "", telefone))
dgp_url <- as.character(cfg$link_dgp)
if (!tem(dgp_url) || grepl("\\[|ID-DO-GRUPO|SEU_ID_AQUI", dgp_url, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  dgp_url <- "https://dgp.cnpq.br"
}

if (secao_ativa("mostrar_contato")) {
div(
  class = "pagina-contato",
  p(class = "contato-intro", cfg$intro_contato),
  div(
    class = "contato-grade",
    div(
      class = "contato-card",
      div(class = "contato-card-icone", tags$i(class = "bi bi-envelope", `aria-hidden` = "true")),
      h3(cfg$titulo_email),
      p(cfg$email),
      tags$a(class = "btn btn-secondary", href = paste0("mailto:", cfg$email), cfg$botao_enviar_email)
    ),
    div(
      class = "contato-card",
      div(class = "contato-card-icone", tags$i(class = "bi bi-instagram", `aria-hidden` = "true")),
      h3(cfg$titulo_instagram),
      p(cfg$instagram_user),
      tags$a(class = "btn btn-secondary", href = cfg$instagram, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener noreferrer", cfg$botao_instagram)
    ),
    div(
      class = "contato-card",
      div(class = "contato-card-icone", tags$i(class = "bi bi-geo-alt", `aria-hidden` = "true")),
      h3(cfg$titulo_localizacao),
      tags$a(
        class = "contato-endereco-mapa",
        href = mapa_url,
        target = "_blank",
        rel = "noopener noreferrer",
        `aria-label` = "Ver endereço do GPENSC no Google Maps",
        endereco
      ),
      tags$a(
        class = "btn btn-secondary contato-mapa-btn",
        href = mapa_url,
        target = "_blank",
        rel = "noopener noreferrer",
        tags$i(class = "bi bi-geo-alt", `aria-hidden` = "true"),
        paste0(" ", cfg$botao_mapa)
      )
    ),
    div(
      class = "contato-card",
      div(class = "contato-card-icone", tags$i(class = "bi bi-telephone", `aria-hidden` = "true")),
      h3(cfg$titulo_telefone),
      p(telefone),
      tags$a(class = "btn btn-secondary", href = telefone_url, "Ligar")
    )
  ),
  div(
    class = "contato-assinatura",
    p(paste(cfg$unidade, cfg$departamento, sep = " · ")),
    tags$a(class = "link-acao", href = dgp_url, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener noreferrer",
           "Diretório dos Grupos de Pesquisa do CNPq")
  )
)
} else {
  estado_vazio("Seção temporariamente indisponível", "Esta seção está desativada nas configurações do site.")
}

```
